mapper.insert: insert into user_current_read(user_id, book_id, chapter_id, sort_id, state) values (#{userId}, #{bookId}, 0, 0, 0) on duplicate key update state = 0
mapper.update: update user_current_read set state = 1 where id = #{id} and state = 0
update user_current_read set state=2 where book_id=#{bookId}
mapper.select: select id, book_id, chapter_id, sort_id, last_read_time from user_current_read where user_id=#{userId} and state=0 order by last_read_time desc, id desc limit 1
